title: Research Report
description: Structured summary of gathered research, including sources, findings, gaps, and canon conflicts. Consumed by brief-writer and section drafters.

report_id.description: Unique identifier for this research report

topic.description: Primary topic or subject of the research

brief_id.description: ID of the brief this research supports, if applicable

research_questions.description: The discrete questions this research was designed to answer

findings.description: Structured list of research findings — each finding maps to one or more research questions

finding.description: The claim or fact established by this finding — stated as a direct assertion

confidence.description: Confidence level: high = verified against authoritative source, medium = supported by secondary source, low = inferred, unverified = reported but not confirmed

source.description: Source citation — file path, guide ID, or external reference

canon_guide_id.description: ID of the canon guide this finding aligns with, if applicable

notes.description: Additional context, caveats, or usage guidance for this finding

source_gaps.description: Research questions that could not be answered — stated specifically enough for the user to supply the missing information

canon_conflicts.description: Claims found in sources that conflict with established canon guides

claim.description: The conflicting claim as found in the source

conflicts_with.description: Canon guide ID or specific canon statement that this claim contradicts

resolution.description: Proposed or confirmed resolution — leave blank if unresolved (escalation required)

ready_for_brief.description: True if all research questions are answered or documented gaps are non-blocking; false if blocking gaps remain

created_by.description: Agent ID that produced this report

run_id.description: Cache run ID this report belongs to
